author: Nature Boy
notes_extra: 90VLDs. 30 in 1:7 Shilen. 600 yard high master, close to 1,000 rounds with no jacket failure. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 223. The 22 cal 90 gr VLD is the target line.

author: XTR
notes_extra: 90 VLDs jammed .010. PT&G ISSF reamer with .169 freebore. 28 in 3-groove Lilja 1:7. Shot 200-12 and 197-11 at 600 yards. He did not name the cartridge in the recipe; Ned Ludd's post in the thread is .223 Rem.

author: Snuggie
notes_extra: He wrote 90 Berger's. Bartlein 6.5 twist, 30 in 5R. Made high master. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is .223. The 22 cal 90 gr VLD is the target line.

author: kevin nevius
notes_extra: Berger 90's. Benchmark 35 in 7 twist, 3 groove. COAL 2.620 is about .010 jump. Sub half minute, ES of 7. He said his loads are Berger 90's in 223 barrels. The 22 cal 90 gr VLD is the target line.

author: kevin nevius
notes_extra: Berger 90's. This is the N140 charge he is using for iron-sight Palma at 1000 yards. ES of 12, on the third reloading. Benchmark 35 in 7 twist. COAL 2.620. The 22 cal 90 gr VLD is the target line.

author: kevin nevius
notes_extra: Berger 90's. ES of 17. Benchmark 35 in 7 twist, Lapua, CCI 450, COAL 2.620. The 22 cal 90 gr VLD is the target line.

author: kevin nevius
notes_extra: Berger 90's. ES of 11. Benchmark 35 in 7 twist, Lapua, CCI 450, COAL 2.620. The 22 cal 90 gr VLD is the target line.

author: seymour fish
notes_extra: Berger 90 vld's jammed about .010. One-hole node from 24.4 to 24.6 gr, second test 2848 and 2852 fps, no pressure signs. 1:7 Shilen .219 bore, freebore punched to .190, mixed unsorted LC, Savage 12. He said he will shoot 24.5 at the next match; that is the plan, not a separate row. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is .223.

author: BoilerUP
notes_extra: 90gr Berger VLD. 22 in 1:7 223AI. OCW he verified over two range trips. COAL 2.49 is about 0.005 jump.

author: BoilerUP
notes_extra: 90gr Berger VLDs. 22 in 223 Ackley with 0.061 freebore. Same charge and rifle as his April 19, 2014 post, which listed 2735 fps.

author: Matt Pitchon
notes_extra: He named 2000MR and N550 together for the same 26 gr charge. 26 in 7.7 twist. He wrote 223 with 90s. The thread is .223 and the 90 gr Berger VLD.

author: Evan
notes_extra: 27.9 gns of Varget with the 90 VLD in the 22 PPC. He called it a hot load with a stiff bolt lift.

author: Evan
